ruling: docs/C4-DECISION-SHEET-2026-08-02.md calls 1, 2, 6 — Captain-ratified 'all defaults' 2026-08-02. Grammar §6a: the printed word is the claim.

rule:activated-animate-other-artifact.definition: An activated ability makes a target noncreature artifact become an artifact creature until end of turn. The printed text says 'target', not 'another', so the source is not excluded (grammar §6a).
rule:activated-animate-other-artifact.why: call 1 — 2 of 2 members print plain 'target'; the -other- claim was unsupported

rule:activated-plus1-counter-transfer-to.definition: An activated ability removes a +1/+1 counter from the SOURCE and puts a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Direction is source -> target; the printed text says 'target creature', not 'another', so the source is not excluded (grammar §6a).
rule:activated-plus1-counter-transfer-to.why: call 1 — Spike Hatcher and Spike Rogue both print 'Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature'. Tier-2 D1 corrected this axis's DIRECTION yesterday and left the -other- claim standing

rule:etb-bounce-other-creature.definition: When the permanent enters, a triggered ability returns target creature to its owner's hand. The printed text says 'target', not 'another' (grammar §6a).
rule:etb-bounce-other-creature.why: call 1 — 6 of 9 members print plain 'target creature' and can bounce themselves

rule:etb-plus1-counter-on-other-creature.definition: When the permanent enters, a triggered ability puts a +1/+1 counter on target creature. The printed text says 'target', not 'another' (grammar §6a); members whose counter goes on the source itself belong on rule:etb-self-plus1-counter.
rule:etb-plus1-counter-on-other-creature.why: call 1 — 15 of 42 members print plain 'target creature'; the -other- claim was unsupported

rule:grants-self-double-strike.definition: A triggered or activated ability gives the SOURCE ITSELF double strike until end of turn. Distinct from rule:grants-double-strike-target, which targets another creature: these members print 'this creature gains double strike' and affect nothing else (grammar §6a).

rule:etb-self-plus1-counter.definition: When the permanent enters, a triggered ability puts one or more +1/+1 counters on the SOURCE ITSELF. Sibling of rule:etb-plus1-counter-on-target-creature; joins the self-counter family (self-plus1-counter-growth, attack-trigger-self-plus1-counter-growth, draw-trigger-self-plus1-counter-growth).

rule:etb-self-tapped-with-stun-counters.definition: The permanent enters tapped and with one or more stun counters on ITSELF, as a printed drawback. Distinct from rule:etb-tap-and-stun-target, which taps and stuns another permanent (grammar §6a).

moves.why: call 2 — each prints 'this creature gains double strike until end of turn' and targets nothing
call 2 — each puts its counter(s) on the source itself, not on another creature
call 2 — each prints 'enters tapped with N stun counters on it': self, no target
